question: Does the unchanged public standard caller release and independently verify input after a 3700 ms private-Xvfb pause under a 4000 ms cancellation transaction deadline?
prior_independent_trial: R38 passed at 3600 ms with 272.051 ms release margin; R39 uses a fresh container and attempt ID.
decision: PASS only if local XRes preflight passes before input; public caller and harness exit 0; release/readback completes before the 4 s transaction deadline; independent all-up readback <= 5 s; all keys up and no delayed b at >= 8.5 s; old and fresh-generation exact task oracles pass; old UNKNOWN/replay denial remains; exact container cleanup succeeds. Otherwise preserve first outcome and do not retry.
